name: Inventec Corporation
summary: Inventec Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, processes, and trades in computers and related products in Taiwan, the United States, Japan, Hong Kong, Macao, Mainland China, and internationally. The company operates through Core Department and Solar Energy Department segments. It offers personal computing products, including notebook PC, desktop/AIO, and thin client; enterprise system solutions, such as servers, blade servers, network switches, storage equipment, and rack solutions, as well as server management software; and networking solutions. The company also provides smart phones and related devices; industrial mobile systems; cloud services, and soft and hard integration solutions; solar cells; networking solutions; electronic materials and products; and business management services. In addition, it is also involved in the provision of wireless terminal products; assembly and sale of computer products; equipment leasing, storage, and technological development and sale of computers; marketing promotion and telecommunication research activities; and house leasing services. Inventec Corporation was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.
